constraints: filtersArr and allowDenyArr must be synchronized element-by-element; '*' can be used as a wildcard within a filtersArr entry to match one or more characters.
To disable URL filtering, pass empty arrays, or pass "*" with True as the last elements of filtersArr/allowDenyArr.
If the same URL appears as both allowed and denied, the last (highest-index) matching setting wins.
Filtering applies only to changes of the Web area's primary URL (user/JS/4D-driven); it does not apply to WA OPEN URL calls or "javascript:" URLs.
Read back the currently active filters with WA GET URL FILTERS.

overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines are the same call with a leading '*' literal-symbol discriminator selecting whether object is an object name (Text) or a direct Variable/Field reference, not two distinct overloads.

params.description: If passed, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is passed) or Variable/Field reference (if * is omitted).

sentinelValues.meaning: wildcard matching one or more characters within a filter entry

discriminatedBy.rule: Text (an object name) when the leading * is passed; Variable or Field passed directly when * is omitted.
